option_relations.rationale: Viral myocarditis is a broader category that includes acute viral myocarditis with cardiogenic shock and pulmonary edema as a specific presentation.

Multisystem inflammatory syndrome in children (MIS-C) is a distinct clinical entity, although it can present with cardiac involvement, it is not directly equivalent to or a subtype of acute viral myocarditis with cardiogenic shock and pulmonary edema.
Bacterial sepsis with myocardial involvement is a different etiology and clinical syndrome compared to acute viral myocarditis with cardiogenic shock and pulmonary edema.

COVID-19 with cardiac injury and thrombocytopenia-associated multiple organ failure (TAMOF) is a specific syndrome related to COVID-19, which is distinct from acute viral myocarditis with cardiogenic shock and pulmonary edema, although viral infections can cause myocarditis.
